_how_to_use: Type words you want to KEEP. A role is shown only if every filter you fill in matches it. Leave a list empty [] to ignore that column. Capital letters do not matter, and a word matches part of a cell - so 'summer' matches 'Summer Internship 2027'.
_examples: Only summer roles in the UK:  "Extra details": ["summer"], "Location/locations": ["united kingdom", "uk"]
